name: Call a Surprise Witness — "It's a Spirit in addition" applies to the chosen creature
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (pronoun-subject clusters). In a spell, _resolveItPronoun rewrites a pronoun subject with no parser form of its own ("It's a …", "it has base power", "that land becomes", 'It gains "…"') to 'Target <noun>'; the add-type parser now honours an explicit target instead of applying to every creature.
